text:
All 10 tests pass.

I made three surgical fixes to `collkit.py`:

1. **`unique`** — Replaced `list(set(items))` with an order-preserving deduplication using a `seen` set, so the first occurrence order is retained (required by `test_unique_order`).

2. **`partition`** — Changed the return from `return no, yes` to `return yes, no`, so matches come first (required by `test_partition_orientation`).

3. **`windows`** — Changed `range(0, len(items) - k)` to `range(0, len(items) - k + 1)`, so the final window is included (required by `test_windows_complete`).

The runner script `run_tests.py` was just to invoke pytest from the workspace root so `collkit` is importable; it doesn't affect the module itself.
